## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews rescued [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) when she nearly fell overboard, catching her by her sash. The two later attended the local picnic together where Jane enjoyed boating on the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters).

- Saved — caught her by her sash when she nearly fell overboard  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
